runtime: Buildless SVG strings generated by ../scene.js. Exports are review/source assets, not a second simulation state.
provenance: Original project vector artwork authored in scene.js for Opening Shift. No legacy or third-party sprites, brand marks, maps, textures, fonts, or external images are included.

scene.projection: Original shallow diagonal cutaway with vertical height cues; stylized scale, not physical dimensions.
scene.offSite: Devices outside the four clinic locations are omitted and counted in the scene footer. No remote/home inset is drawn.
scene.roomMove: An observation recorded in another source-device location remains model evidence but is not painted as a route in the new room.

helpers.getDeviceAnchors: getDeviceAnchors(view) => {[deviceId]:{x,y}} in normalized scene coordinates; off-site devices omitted
helpers.renderDeviceArtwork: renderDeviceArtwork(kind, {powered=true, selected=false, label=""}) => decorative SVG string
helpers.SCENE_ANCHORS: Frozen reception, examA, examB and equipment map exactly matching CONTRACT.md

accessibility.keyboard: Native HTML device selection and action controls supplied by ui.js; the SVG has no required interactive target.
accessibility.motion: No animation, timing, precision pointing or essential hover.
accessibility.text: Room signs and scene captions are visual supplements. UI repeats essential device facts and test results as selectable HTML.

limitations: No radio physics, subnet geometry, patient queue, waiting-time outcome, clinical data or clinical result is represented.
Neutral cable and Wi-Fi association strokes are not service claims.
Gold route highlighting requires an explicit current player observation and matching actual witness edge endpoints.
SVG static raster inspection is not an interactive browser or school-device acceptance test.
